table.retrieve:
SELECT  PL.purinvcode,
	ITEMNAME=I.name,
	purrowid=PD.purrowid,
	stock=isnull(PD.currstock,0),
	packingdesc=I.packingdesc,
	packunits=PD.packunits,
	qty= (Case PL.purcatcode
			 when 1    then PD.looseqty
			 when 7    then PD.looseqty
			 when 8    then PD.looseqty
			Else PD.packqty
			End),
	purprice=PD.purprice,
	totalprice=Round(((Case PL.purcatcode
						 when 1    then PD.looseqty * PD.purprice
			 				when 7    then PD.looseqty * PD.purprice
			 				when 8    then PD.looseqty * PD.purprice
							Else PD.packqty * PD.purprice
							End)  * ( 1 - PD.discperc*0.01)) * (1 - PL.discperc * 0.01),2) ,
	supplier=(select name from accounts where acccode=PL.suppcode),
	purtype=isnull((select name from purchasetype where purtypecode=PL.purtypecode),'Null'),
	invtotal=Round(((Case PL.purcatcode
						 when 1    then PD.looseqty * PD.purprice
			 				when 7    then PD.looseqty * PD.purprice
			 				when 8    then PD.looseqty * PD.purprice
							Else PD.packqty * PD.purprice
							End)  * ( 1 - PD.discperc*0.01)) * (1 - PL.discperc * 0.01),2)
				/*Case when (select min(purrowid) from purdetail where purdetail.purinvcode=PL.purinvcode) = PD.purrowid THEN
				(SELECT  
		
					Net=ROUND(
					SUM((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty + purdetail.bonusqty) *
						purdetail.unitsalestax) +
						SUM(ROUND((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty) * purdetail.purprice * 
						(1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc)) * purdetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
						ROUND((SUM(((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty) * purdetail.purprice) * 
						(1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc))) * 
						(1- (.01 * purledger.discperc)) - purledger.flatdisc) * 
						(purledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) + ROUND(SUM((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty) * purdetail.purprice * 
						(1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * purledger.discperc)) + 
						purledger.misccharges + purledger.salestax - purledger.flatdisc, 0)
				FROM     purledger,	 
							 purdetail
				WHERE    	 
		 				purledger.purinvcode=PL.purinvcode and
						purledger.purinvcode = purdetail.purinvcode 
				GROUP BY purledger.purinvcode,
		 				purledger.suppcode, 
		 				purledger.purcatcode,
		 				purledger.postdate,
		 				purledger.discperc,
		 				purledger.misccharges,
		 				purledger.salestax,
		 				purledger.flatdisc,
		 				purledger.InvGSTPerc1
			)/* end of invoice total*/
			Else
				0
			End*/

FROM 		Item I,
     		Purledger PL,
     		purdetail PD

WHERE 	PL.date>=:ad_sdate  AND
			PL.date<= :ad_ldate  AND
			PL.purinvcode=PD.purinvcode AND
			PL.posted='Y' AND
			PD.icode=I.icode
ORDER BY PL.purinvcode, PD.purrowid

props.rows: purinvcode, itemname, packingdesc, packunits, qty, purprice, totalprice, supplier, stock, purrowid
props.sourcenames: purinvcode, itemname, purrowid, stock, packingdesc, packunits, qty, purprice, totalprice, supplier, purtype, invtotal
